title: The Meghalaya Right to Public Services Act, 2020 (Act No. 18 of 2020)
full_text: The Meghalaya Right to Public Services Act, 2020 (Act No. 18 of 2020) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202018 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2020-11-20 Act Year: 2020 Short Title: The Meghalaya Right to Public Services Act, 2020 (Act No. 18 of 2020) Long Title: to provide for the delivery of notified public services to the citizens in the State of Meghalaya within the stipulated time limit including liabilities of the government servants, in case of default and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
